data.narrative:
SiFly, a Series A defense and security company founded by Brian Hinman, has raised $15M+ to date. Valuation analysis draws on two methodologies triangulated against a peer universe of 11 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage companies—8 private and 2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS). The private comp set includes Anduril Industries, Helsing, Singularity, NODA AI, and Castelion, with valuations ranging $125M–$3.0B.

Stage-progression analysis, applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A-to-next-stage advancement to the $15M raised proxy, implies a $30M valuation. Peer-median methodology across the 11-company Defense & Security comp set yields $1.0B, with the peer range spanning $125M (floor) to $3.0B (ceiling). The median peer represents a Series B cohort meaningfully ahead of SiFly's current stage.

Triangulation of both methods produces a range of $26M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $515M. The wide spread reflects material stage and maturity dispersion within the peer set. Key uncertainties include SiFly's specific technology differentiation, customer concentration, and revenue traction relative to the Series B comparables. A post-seed to Series A valuation would more conservatively favor the $26M–$515M range, pending disclosure of revenue, customer pipeline, or product-market validation metrics.
